import sys
from array import array


def tokens():
    # Stream integers in 1 MiB chunks so the whole input never sits in memory as a token list.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        yield from map(int, chunk[:cut].split())
    yield from map(int, rest.split())


def main():
    it = tokens()
    limit = next(it, 0)
    window = next(it, 0)
    next(it, 0)  # n: exactly n (timestamp, size) pairs follow, read until EOF
    total = 0
    used = 0  # bytes of accepted logs still inside the window
    # Queue of accepted logs with positive size, oldest first; compact typed arrays keep memory low.
    times = array("Q")
    sizes = array("L")
    head = 0
    for t in it:
        size = next(it)
        # Expire while t - oldTime > window.
        while head < len(times) and t - times[head] > window:
            used -= sizes[head]
            head += 1
        if head > 65536 and head * 2 > len(times):
            del times[:head]
            del sizes[:head]
            head = 0
        if used + size <= limit:
            used += size
            total += size
            if size:
                times.append(t)
                sizes.append(size)
    print(total)


main()
